newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUTAKIRJA UNIT BUYS ESTONIAN KIOSKS.
newsitem.headline: RAUTAKIRJA UNIT BUYS ESTONIAN KIOSKS.

text.p: Finnish retail group Rautakirja Oy said on Monday its Estonian subsidiary Lehti-Maja Eesti AS had bought a chain of 66 kiosks in Estonia from Estonian AS Micronet group for an undisclosed sum.
"The business operations now purchased had net sales of about 30 million Estonian kroons (about 11.5 million markka) and about 100 employees," Rautakirja said in a statement.
Before the purchase, Lehti-Maja had 39 kiosks in its R-kiosk chain, it said.
"The now acquired kiosks will be renovated in accordance with the R-kiosk chain concept," it said, adding it would set up a central warehouse in Tallinn due to the increase in outlets.
"Lehti-Maja Eesti's target is to develop and grow the R-kiosk chain in Estonia in the future too," it said.
